shared_elements: monolithic anthropomorphic pillar/figure with carving in low relief
low relief motifs arranged in horizontal registers
curved/arched motifs repeated in a row across the upper zone
animal or creature figures in relief on the body of the monolith
schematic linear incised detail on lower part
ring/disc-like element on the front surface
justification: Both are upright monolithic anthropomorphic slabs bearing shallow relief carvings organised in stacked horizontal registers, with a row of repeated arch/curved motifs across the upper zone, creature figures below, and a prominent ring or disc element on the front. However, A's registers show clearly identifiable birds and quadrupeds in profile with a hatched chevron/branch motif on the shaft, while B's motifs are more abstract, symmetrical and paired (paired curved forms, double rings, a broad belt-like arc) with no recognisable profile animals, so the specific iconographic vocabulary differs substantially.
